title: Degraded order create: inventory-service latency tracked memory usage
symptoms: occasional allocation failures or container restarts late in the incident
latency growing in step with memory, not with a sudden traffic spike
errors appearing late in the window after a long slow period
observed_signals: GC pause time and heap-used warnings increased with memory
CPU increased only moderately until GC became frequent
memory_usage rose smoothly over a long period rather than in a single jump
latency correlated with memory; errors arrived later

timeline.event: traffic was unremarkable at the start
memory_usage on inventory-service began a near-linear climb
p95 latency on inventory-service moved with memory
error-rate or latency alert fired on inventory-service
a second climb started until the code fix landed

contributing_factors: server-side sessions accumulated for users who never logged out
the memory limit was close to the working set even when healthy
resolution: cleared server-side sessions that were never expired
set a max session map size
restarted pods that had already crossed 90% RSS
lessons_learned: page on sustained memory slope, not only on OOM
a restart that restores latency is mitigation, not a fix
